settings.heading: Us vs. Them
settings.subtext: Most gut supplements choose either prebiotics or probiotics. Zylla Fiber gives you both — plus digestive enzymes — in a single daily sachet.

settings.heading: What's Inside
settings.content: Each sachet contains 3g Inulin (chicory root), 2g Psyllium Husk, 5 Billion CFU Probiotic Blend (Lactobacillus acidophilus, Bifidobacterium longum), and a Digestive Enzyme Complex (Amylase, Protease, Lactase). No artificial sweeteners or colours.

settings.heading: How to Use
settings.content: Mix one sachet with 200–300ml of water in the morning, before or with breakfast. Staying well-hydrated helps the fiber work effectively. If you're new to fiber supplements, start with half a sachet for the first week to let your gut adjust.

settings.heading: The Science
settings.content: Most adults consume only half the recommended daily fiber intake. Prebiotic fiber feeds beneficial bacteria, while probiotics directly add them. Taking both together (synbiotics) is clinically shown to be significantly more effective than either alone. The digestive enzyme complex helps break down specific foods that commonly cause bloating.
